item.title: Prices fall, weights land, scoreboards shift
item.description:
The week in frontier models: OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra and Mistral Large 4 both pushed prices down, while Artificial Analysis reshuffled its index. Mistral's open weights arrived two days early, with a licence catch. Also: the Foundry route for European deployment, self-hosting options, and what independent tests say about the vendor's claims.
